snippet.title: Space Hauler | Space Sim Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4327900/Space_Hauler/?utm_source=youtube

Space Hauler is a space flight sim set around Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Fly your spacecraft using realistic aerodynamics and orbital mechanics, take on contracts, and build your career as a pilot-for-hire.

Immerse yourself in the experience with optional VR support, and fly with your preferred HOTAS, flight stick, or gamepad.

Join the discussion on Discord and to sign up for future playtests:
https://discord.gg/aEcmcBfXnU
---
